en.text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，弟兄和睦同居 是何等地善，何等地美！

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，弟兄和睦同居 是何等地善，何等地美！

en.text: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

zhSimplified.text: 这好比那贵重的油浇在亚伦的头上， 流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟；

zhTraditional.text: 這好比那貴重的油澆在亞倫的頭上， 流到鬍鬚，又流到他的衣襟；

en.text: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

zhSimplified.text: 又好比黑门的甘露降在锡安山； 因为在那里有耶和华所命定的福， 就是永远的生命。

zhTraditional.text: 又好比黑門的甘露降在錫安山； 因為在那裏有耶和華所命定的福， 就是永遠的生命。
